thread:
incidents-bot: Pager: SEV=2 detected for /models/rope-ntk (long-context). KV-cache usage spike + continuous-batching backlog. 5m error rate + 99th latency > 6s. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/alerts/ALERT-9821 :rotating_light:

sara.nguyen: I'm taking this one — on-call. Pulling traces and recent deploys. ETA 2m.

matthew: I'm online. Seeing a bunch of large NTK windows hitting the cache with very low reuse (sliding window). YaRN experiments look like they started at 22:41 UTC which matches the spike.

alex: tagging infra — possible KV-cache blowup via unbounded per-request prefix keys. If prefixes are long we create many entries and eviction stalls.

jane: Confirmed high eviction churn on kv-node-7 and kv-node-3: logs show repeated create+evict loops. Sample log: ```[2024-04-05T22:43:10Z] kvstore: PUT key=rope:session:xxxx size=12MB evict=1 reason=memory_pressure```

kyra: Customer impact check: our SLO customers on Dedicated showing tail latency ~8-12s for gen endpoints. No 500s yet but timeouts creeping. CS pinged for top 10 active customers.

ops-bot: Automatic mitigation attempted: disabled continuous_batching for model rope-ntk in region us-west-2 at 22:45:03 UTC (task id: mb-hotfix-197).

matthew: That bot action looks partial — continuous_batching flag only toggled on the router layer, not on the runtime config. Need to patch runtime batch_window_ms and max_batch_size.

sara.nguyen: Quick plan: 1) scale kv nodes + increase eviction throughput 2) roll back YaRN sliding-window experiment 3) apply temporary batching caps on rope-ntk runtimes 4) notify customers. Any objections?

alex: +1. I'll scale kv pool by +50% now. Running: ```kubectl -n infra scale statefulset kvstore --replicas=9```

jane: Rolling back YaRN experiment: ```/ops/experiments rollback yarn/sliding-window --tag rope-ntk --confirm``` — queued, will push in 30s.

kyra: CS update: sent message to impacted workspace contacts, flagged for follow-up.

matthew: Hotpatch to runtime batching (applied to canary set first). Patch: ```PATCH /internal/runtime/config
{ "model": "rope-ntk",
  "continuous_batch": { "enabled": false, "max_batch_size": 32, "window_ms": 20 }
}
```

dev-bot: Runtime canary apply succeeded on 2 nodes (rt-canary-4, rt-canary-5). Monitoring logs.

sara.nguyen: Observing 30s after runtime patch: 99th latency dropped from ~8s -> ~2.3s on canary. Eviction rate on kv nodes also stabilizing. Good signal.

ops-bot: Kvstore pool scaled to 9 replicas; rebalancer started. Memory pressure events decreased.

matthew: Pushed full rollout of batching cap to us-west-2 runtimes at 22:52:11 UTC. Watch for regressions. If anything, we can revert to previous config with the API: ```curl -XPOST https://control-plane.internal/models/rope-ntk/rollout/revert -d '{}'```

jane: Yarn experiment rollback completed at 22:53:08 UTC. No further large sliding-window sessions seen in the last 4m.

kyra: CS update: 12 customers saw elevated latency, all notified. No orders/transactions lost. Will open follow-up tickets for each org.

alex: On-call handoff: I can stay with active monitoring for 30m, then hand to matthew. Leaving notes in the incident doc.

sara.nguyen: Thanks all. Immediate mitigation worked: batching caps + scaling + experiment rollback. Action items: - postmortem with root cause (NTK sliding-window + YaRN interaction) - add guardrails to continuous_batch config to prevent unbounded key proliferation - add metric alert on per-session key churn - run a canary for any long-context feature for 48h before ramping to prod.

matthew: Filed follow-up tickets: INC-9821-PO, INFRA-2217, RUNTIME-1439. I'll pick up the 30m monitoring shift after alex.

dev-bot: Incident marker: severity reduced to SEV=3 at 22:58:40 UTC.

sara.nguyen: Closing active pager. Leaving this thread open for notes and postmortem drafts. If anyone has logs/screenshots add them here. :white_check_mark:
